scope: Stable legible lighting as the camera moves, clear high-density phone rendering with usable quality choices, recovery after mobile backgrounding or graphics loss that preserves the world and authoring session, and intuitive house interior entry and exterior return with playable desktop/phone controls.

intuitiveness.evidence: The inspected phone images show prominent Enter cabin and Return outside actions, separate First person controls, a recoverable authoring drawer, and legible quality choices. The actual Pascal browser journey enters a regional cabin from Explore, walks inside, restores the same session after WebGL loss and returns to the exact outside pose; Undo/Redo remain usable. The new recovery dialog supplies explicit retry and export, including rejected raw checkpoint data. However, imported house shells still have no admitted interior journey, and the affected physical phone has not confirmed background recovery or the corrected clarity. Those material requirements keep the complete scope below B+.

accuracy.evidence: Independent source inspection found and followed corrections for malformed selection/controller admission, fresh-tab null storage keys, reload loops, timeout callbacks, pending-entry masks, save acknowledgments and transaction aborts. Current admission checks every Undo/Redo world separately and validates interior ownership, return camera and groundwork context; the save/read size policies and stored visual style are explicit. Completed CGE frames now drive the performance sample rather than unrelated JavaScript RAF callbacks. The highp, bounded bump correction removes a real mobile numerical hazard. This critic's earlier sign-only light diagnosis was wrong and is explicitly retracted: inherited model Direction aims local +Z while the light emits -Z. Explicit MinusZ orientation makes the current light convention clear. Successful desktop GPU emulation does not establish that the user's camera-dependent black surfaces, fuzzy rendering and minimize/resume failure are fixed on that phone, and deterministic storage/late-reply/extended-host coverage remains incomplete.

wowFactor.evidence: Actual captures show a lit furnished studio, full walking walls and ceiling, clear directional UI, and a visibly retained Toon treatment after recovery. The ivory and dark-green interface remains coherent. The scene is usable and substantially improved over the black/blank failure history, but the tall ceiling framing and strongly repeated floor grain remain visually plain, with pronounced streaks under Toon. Broader camera sweeps and the affected phone still need to demonstrate stable, clear surfaces; empty imported house shells and a limited enterable set prevent the complete house experience from being compelling at B+.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: Combining an independently admitted world/history checkpoint with a clean engine reload provides a practical recovery path around the pinned web backend's missing safe in-place graphics restart. Preserving the exterior return camera, authoring mask, controller context and visual style makes that restart useful rather than simply returning to a title screen. Proximity entry reuses the existing WFC studio/plan adapter and distinguishes regional and supported ownership, including a scoped first visit while exploring. These combinations have demonstrated benefit; they do not substitute for missing house profiles or device acceptance.

blockingFindings: MRR-01: Verify the affected physical Android/Brave phone on the current served build. Revisit the reported black surfaces at the same poses and through camera movement, compare None rendering and quality modes, background/minimize and resume, then exercise entry/return and continued authoring. Record device/browser, actual completed-frame timing and drawing-buffer/CSS dimensions. The earlier user confirmation 'Yes loads now' closed startup transport only; it is not evidence for these newer visual/lifecycle symptoms. Keep this gate held until those observed failures are closed.

MRR-02: Complete the house-entry requirement for the imported house shells. Current UpdateEntry admits only cabin assets and other house profiles have no admitted interiors. Add measured, compatible room/entry profiles and identity-preserving entry/return transactions, then demonstrate desktop and phone use. Do not narrow the registered scope to cabins or mark an unsupported shell as enterable merely because it resembles a house.

MRR-03: Extend deterministic recovery coverage beyond the successful regional studio and fresh-tab unavailable-storage cases. Remaining cases include a blocked database, quota and synchronous put failure, over-limit save preserving the prior checkpoint, an actual downloaded rejected-history recovery file, timeout followed by a late worker reply, loss before a world exists, and background/loss during a delayed entry with a nontrivial selection mask. Verify exact current world, both populated history stacks and pose/controller state. Add a rotated supported cabin and a furnished named-room plan with a selected nested object, plus freshness checks when the nearby target changes. These are residual verification gaps, not claims that the already corrected source cases are still failing.

MRR-04: Demonstrate stable lighting and useful sharpness across top/orbit/fly/walk and multiple views of the same material surfaces, including grazing angles and restored styles. The shader correction is supported by numerical source reasoning, but the original device symptom's cause is not proven by that reasoning. Keep general performance/audio/all-catalog claims separate, and do not infer physical-phone FPS from the mixed desktop instrumentation intervals.
resolvedFindings: Initial {} or array selection admission, arbitrary interior room/selected IDs and missing return-camera editing type were tightened before publication.
Missing sessionStorage keys are normalized; automatic reloads are budgeted even before a world exists; recovery timeout terminates the worker and ignores failed callbacks.
Pending entry now cancels and synchronizes the original mask before loss/background saves; stale save Boolean evidence was replaced by save revision acknowledgments.
Snapshot creation occurs before the transaction, synchronous put failure aborts, rejected checkpoints remain exportable, and size preflight retains the prior checkpoint on failure.

The former tiny mediump determinant-scaled normal was replaced with highp derivatives, a scaled gradient and bounded fallback; light orientation is now explicit. The critic's earlier sign-only recommendation was retracted in retained history.

Final save preflight enforces the 32 Mi-character session and 8 Mi-character world bounds before opening a write transaction. Fresh-tab unavailable storage now reports a nonblocking warning; actual denied-storage tests retain the live world and expose Export after loss.
The final native dialog keeps keyboard focus inside, focuses retry, prevents Escape exposing the failed renderer, and permits an explicitly requested retry after repeated context loss.
